'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Veer DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Veer]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
